# Mobile Layout Review (390px)

## 1) Header — ✅ Fits
- Green "G" logo + "AI Studio" title sit on one line with comfortable spacing.
- No cramping, no wrapping, no truncation.

## 2) Step chips — ⚠️ Mostly fine, one issue
- The 6 numbered chips (1–6) are arranged in a horizontal row, and the row appears scrollable (chip 1 is highlighted as active).
- **Issue:** "1 1" — the active chip shows a duplicated/wrong label. The active chip displays both a boxed "1" and a bare "1" beside it, while others show the correct pattern (e.g., "2 2", "3 3"). If the design intends number + step name (e.g., "1 Brief"), the label is missing/truncated. Worth checking, but not a layout breakage.

## 3) Content readability — ✅ Good
- **Heading** "What are we building?" fits on one line, no clipping.
- **Paragraph** wraps cleanly across 4 lines with no overflow.
- **Textarea** spans full width with a readable placeholder ("e.g. a neighbourhood bakery that takes pre-orders" wraps properly). Resize handle at bottom-right is visible but not causing overflow.
- **Example chips** ("a restaurant that takes bookings", etc.) wrap as plain text lines — readable, no horizontal scroll.
- **Helper text** "plain words, no jargon needed" aligns right of "YOUR BRIEF" without collision.

## 4) Layout breakage — ⚠️ Minor issues only
- ✅ No horizontal overflow anywhere; no overlapping elements.
- ✅ Bottom info card ("Not sure yet? Start from the whole library") with "Browse all 23 templates" link renders cleanly inside its border.
- ⚠️ "Pick a starting point first" caption sits very close to the floating avatar button (black "N" circle) at bottom-left — tight but not overlapping.
- ⚠️ The floating avatar button partially overlaps the bottom whitespace; fine, but ensure it doesn't cover content when scrolled.

**Verdict:** No blocking issues. Clean up the duplicated "1 1" chip label and give the bottom caption a bit more breathing room from the floating button.
